build.note: The evidenced build and the declared direction do not match, and that gap is the single most important thing in this tree. Sustained, repeated, high-quality evidence exists for building tools, dashboards, spreadsheets, brand assets and copy. The AIGO identity is real as an intention and as a body of unpaid work, but the nodes that would validate it — Sales, Growth Experiments, Business Income — hold zero evidence. Claude has repeatedly named tool-building as avoidance of outreach; the tree independently reproduces that finding from evidence alone.

execution.note: Tempered by follow-through: consistency and operations nodes carry the other 60% of this score.

quests.name: Chapter One: one coach, one real fix, one pitch
quests.description: The action already agreed and not yet done. Pick one specific coach, audit their funnel for real, build the actual fix, and pitch with the work in hand. Sales sits at zero and it is the only node standing between an evidenced Builder and a validated AI Growth Operator. Nothing else in this tree unlocks what this unlocks.
quests.reward: First evidence on ent.sales; opens the path to Business Income and First Real Client
quests.proof: A named coach, a real audit, a delivered build, and a pitch actually sent.

quests.name: Ship one automation that runs on live data
quests.description: Zapier is listed as one of your primary tools and Automation Tools holds 15 XP — all of it exploration, ceiling 2. That is the clearest knowledge-versus-experience gap in the tree. One workflow running unattended on real outreach data lifts the ceiling on the whole automation chain from 2 to 6.
quests.reward: +40–80 Automation XP; lifts Automation Tools' ceiling from 2 to 6
quests.proof: A Zap that has run unattended on real records for a week.

quests.name: Measure one thing you already shipped
quests.description: Growth Diagnosis & Strategy sits at level 4 on diagnosis alone: you audit funnels and name leaks constantly, but nothing in the evidence has a recorded before and after. Take one asset already delivered — the Essy landing page, a sequence, the outreach approach — and attach real numbers to it. Measurement is what separates diagnosing from operating.
quests.reward: +50–90 Business XP, and the first measured result in the tree
quests.unlocks: Raises the ceiling on Growth Diagnosis & Strategy toward 8
quests.proof: A before figure, an after figure, and a stated conclusion.

quests.name: Four unbroken weeks
quests.description: Consistency is named in your own memory as the recurring theme across gym, diet and business, and it is the reason Discipline and Training Consistency both sit at zero while Technique and Knowledge do not. Pick one — training is the cheapest to prove — and log four consecutive weeks.
quests.proof: Four consecutive weeks logged, with the bad weeks included rather than restarted.

quests.name: Do not build the next tool
quests.description: An inverted quest, and the hardest one here. The tree's own evidence says tool-building is your strongest skill and your most reliable avoidance mechanism — your success-plan already bans new infrastructure before a signed client. This skill tree is itself infrastructure. Use it once a week and do not extend it until Chapter One is done.
quests.reward: Protects every other quest on this list
quests.proof: Chapter One is complete and no new tool was built in the meantime.

TV command center, co-pilot, two trackers, portfolio. Reaches for a dashboard reflexively — already covered by tech.dashboards.
